claims.description: Cross-account FORBIDDEN case asserts zero speaking_practice_attempts rows for both the caller profile and the attacker-targeted profile after the rejected request.
Missing-profile PROXY_MODE case asserts zero speaking_practice_attempts rows for the fixture profile after the rejected request.

Assertions run inside the existing integration suite that boots the exported production app against the isolated real integration database (createIntegrationDb), same harness as the sibling cases; residue-set completeness anchored on the single transactional insert in the service.
